categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three main business segments: (1) Vehicle-mounted LNG (Liquefied Natural Gas) supply systems for heavy-duty trucks and engineering vehicles, (2) LNG-powered ship fuel systems for inland and ocean vessels, and (3) Lithium-ion battery negative electrode material graphitization processing and sales. The company is a leading manufacturer of vehicle-mounted LNG supply systems in China with consistent market leadership since 2018.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including intelligent automated production lines for LNG supply system modules, high-temperature graphitization processing at 2800-3000°C for battery negative electrode materials, and specialized low-temperature insulation container design and manufacturing. Core technologies include lightweight design, vacuum maintenance systems, high-pressure direct injection modules, and integrated supply system architectures that differentiate products in the market.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major Chinese commercial vehicle manufacturers such as FAW Jiefang, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group (Jinan and Jining), Dongfeng Commercial Vehicles, Shaanxi Heavy Truck, and Beijing Foton Daimler. End markets include heavy-duty truck manufacturers, engineering vehicle producers, inland and ocean shipping companies, and lithium-ion battery manufacturers. The company serves the clean energy vehicle and battery industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Changchun, Jilin Province. It maintains branch offices in Chengdu and Shanghai, and operates subsidiaries in Suzhou (Jiangsu Province), Shiyan (Hubei Province), and other locations. The company has established a nationwide service network with 9 regional offices and 500 authorized service stations across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. For vehicle-mounted LNG systems, it manufactures and supplies components to heavy-duty truck manufacturers. For battery negative electrode materials, it provides graphitization processing services to battery material producers. The company sources raw materials upstream and delivers finished products to vehicle and battery manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing lightweight design technology, extending vehicle range through larger capacity systems, improving vacuum maintenance performance, developing high-pressure direct injection modules, and expanding into hydrogen fuel cell systems. R&D initiatives focus on LNG supply system innovation, liquid hydrogen storage technology, intelligent manufacturing automation, and new energy vehicle platform development. The company emphasizes simultaneous application, development, and reserve of successive technology generations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products including vehicle-mounted LNG supply systems, LNG ship fuel systems, and battery negative electrode materials. Secondary revenue comes from graphitization processing services provided on a fee-per-ton basis to battery material customers. The company also generates minor revenue from equipment rental and asset use rights licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the market leader in vehicle-mounted LNG supply systems in China, maintaining the leading market share since 2018. In the LNG ship fuel system sector, the company competes with recognized enterprises including China International Marine Containers and Houpu Clean Energy, positioning itself in the industry's front tier. The company faces intense competition in the battery negative electrode graphitization sector from larger integrated battery material enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of 1.152 billion yuan, representing a 35.18% decline from 2023's 1.777 billion yuan. Net loss attributable to parent company shareholders was 191.9 million yuan compared to net profit of 56.2 million yuan in 2023. Total assets decreased to 2.227 billion yuan from 2.537 billion yuan year-over-year. The company experienced significant challenges in 2024 with asset impairment charges of 207.9 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced intelligent manufacturing capabilities, superior product quality and reliability, comprehensive technical support and after-sales service (7×24×1 service model), lightweight and high-efficiency design innovations, and deep customer relationships with major OEMs. The company emphasizes precision engineering, safety performance, and cost-effectiveness while maintaining industry-leading market position through continuous technology innovation and customer-centric service delivery.
